name: Bed
lead: A bed is a dyeable utility block that allows a player in the Overworld to sleep through the night and change their spawn point to within a few blocks of the bed, as long as it is not broken or obstructed. Villagers sleep in beds at night and require spare beds to produce offspring .
Beds are used by pressing the use item button while looking at the bed.

recipes.ingredients: Any Bed + Bone Meal or Lapis Lazuli or Cocoa Beans or Ink Sac
